mandatory_semantics: All retained values require provenance. Optional roles may be denied explicitly; mandatory=false never authorizes unbound values.

roles.rationale: Production eligibility is versioned configuration evaluated at the current cutoff.
roles.receipt_requirement: record inventory, version/content hash, current-run eligibility

roles.rationale: Issuer/security identity is persisted source-owned metadata, not a live quote.
roles.freshness_rule: existing security identity and basis contracts
roles.receipt_requirement: security record identity/version and original source provenance

roles.rationale: Stored investment logic and business configuration are explicit versioned inputs.
roles.receipt_requirement: exact record/version/hash; exclude prior AI outputs and query-time prices

roles.rationale: Current query-time chart/technical price ownership; all three reads belong to the price attempt.
roles.freshness_rule: existing payload identity, adjustment, OHLC integrity and completed-bar/session rules
roles.retry_behavior: recollect complete required set per attempt
roles.fallback_policy: no inherited cache or secondary provider
roles.receipt_requirement: every actual request/refetch, exact source bytes/artifact, timing, normalization and validator

roles.rationale: Current valuation price is separate from adjusted chart prices.
roles.freshness_rule: existing raw/adjusted and session/security basis rules
roles.receipt_requirement: unadjusted weekly source-read binding; never substitute adjusted price

roles.rationale: Current indices/style/sector/big-tech prices define the query-time market snapshot.
roles.freshness_rule: MARKET_SYMBOLS registry; existing market temporal/session validator
roles.receipt_requirement: one receipt per actual symbol request and normalized observation

roles.rationale: ka20001/ka20003/ka20009 describe the current KR market query.
roles.freshness_rule: existing matched session/date and typed cross-section quality
roles.receipt_requirement: request/page artifact and normalized role with original query time

roles.rationale: Current flows/concentration are query-time context; optional gaps retain owner denial.
roles.retry_behavior: fresh complete page set for each attempt; no mixed pages
roles.receipt_requirement: all page reads and exact scale/aggregation lineage

roles.rationale: Official facts are versioned filing evidence; a five-minute price retry does not require another filing download.
roles.freshness_rule: existing filing/PIT, selected-source quality, canonical period/currency/lineage rules
roles.retry_behavior: same eligible seed version; required refresh outside price retries
roles.receipt_requirement: record/fact/filing identity and version hash; original receipt where available; current eligibility

roles.rationale: Persisted official statement facts are reusable under existing period/quality rules.
roles.receipt_requirement: corporate identity, receipt/report period, version/hash, current eligibility

roles.rationale: Derived domains reuse canonical input facts; adapter does not recalculate them.
roles.retry_behavior: same seed and input fact IDs
roles.receipt_requirement: derived/input lineage, source dates/version, current eligibility

roles.rationale: Provider-period estimates are not query-time stock prices; reuse only when existing freshness permits.
roles.freshness_rule: existing estimate/security basis and source-use eligibility
roles.fallback_policy: exclude Alpha estimates/shares/overview even from cache
roles.receipt_requirement: provider-period/version/hash and current typed eligibility

roles.rationale: New event collection is run-scoped; a price retry must not refresh the interpretation input.
roles.freshness_rule: existing publication cutoff, identity/relevance and source-use rules
roles.receipt_requirement: run acquisition ID, original publication/time/source artifact, normalized event lineage

roles.rationale: Calendar context collected by the macro run is frozen once, not after every price retry.
roles.receipt_requirement: request/result hash and original event dates

roles.rationale: Official completed-session daily file is acquired once and is not an intraday quote.
roles.receipt_requirement: official file bytes/hash, acquisition time and original session

roles.rationale: Morning gate requires current-run acquisition of eligible configured overnight products, not a new night session at each price retry.
roles.retry_behavior: same run acquisition and original overnight time
roles.receipt_requirement: exact configured night_futures_product_scope source artifacts/receipts and run binding; never relabel as 08:10 price

roles.rationale: Official observations have publication frequency and may legitimately predate the current quote.
roles.freshness_rule: existing macro temporal eligibility; no new day thresholds
roles.receipt_requirement: series/date/publication/version/hash and current temporal eligibility

roles.rationale: Publication-based energy context is reusable when eligible.
roles.receipt_requirement: series/unit/publication/version/hash and current eligibility

roles.rationale: BOK observations are publication-based, not attempt-fresh market prices.
roles.receipt_requirement: series/period/unit/version/source receipt where available

roles.rationale: Published official event evidence can be reused under existing temporal rules.
roles.receipt_requirement: event/source/date/version and current eligibility

roles.rationale: Explicit previous US session context is not a second live US collection or a fresh KR quote.
roles.receipt_requirement: original source/session/hash and overnight usage classification

roles.rationale: Default Alpha provider is excluded by this task; an optional FX gap is explicit.
roles.receipt_requirement: owner denial with no value; cached Alpha observation/briefing also excluded

roles.rationale: Both live and persisted Alpha values are excluded regardless of credentials.
roles.receipt_requirement: source policy exclusion, no missing-to-zero

roles.rationale: Mock and Massive are not authorized in unified source collection.
roles.receipt_requirement: pre-dispatch rejection and persisted-source exclusion

optional_denial_rule: An optional Class C role may retain Class C with a bound record/version and independently replayed owner denial, without a value. Legacy explicit Class D denials remain supported for optional roles. The frozen role inventory never changes to express availability; mandatory roles cannot be denied.
